[[File:Hill giant club detail.png|150px|left]]
The '''hill giant club''' is a two-handed [[melee]] [[weapon]] requiring 40 [[Attack]] to equip. It is currently the best-in-slot weapon for [[crush]] bonuses in [[free-to-play]], possessing very similar stats to a [[rune 2h sword]] but with the [[slash]] and crush bonuses swapped, though the rune 2h sword has a slightly higher slash bonus than the crush bonus of the club.

It can be obtained by opening the [[Chest (Obor's lair)|chest]] in [[Obor]]'s lair, which requires first killing Obor then using a [[giant key]]. Keys can be obtained from Obor, the chest itself, or [[hill giant]]s, of which the ones in the [[Wilderness]] have the highest chance to drop a key.

This weapon is commonly used in [[free-to-play]] [[PvP]] activities as a knockout weapon, especially during the so-called [[Free-to-play PvP culture#Risk fighting|risk fights]], as well as safe activities such as [[Clan Wars]] and [[Castle Wars]]. It is notable for being more accurate against opponents in full [[rune armour]] than the [[rune 2h sword]]. It can be used as a slash weapon for cutting spider webs.
